clue.text: No charm in a ball arranged by US President

indicators.note: arranged means the letters of the preceding words are set out in a new order

explanation.surface: A charm-free dance has been organised by an American head of state.
explanation.walkthrough: 'arranged' turns the fourteen letters of NO CHARM IN A BALL into the president's full name.
explanation.definitionFit: Lincoln was the sixteenth holder of the American presidency.

clue.text: Criticise reduction in personnel

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both to disparage something and a gradual cutback in staff or operations.

clue.text: Pledge to provide white wine

definitions.meaning: to pawn an item as security
a German white from the Rhineland

explanation.walkthrough: 'to provide' is a link joining the two meanings.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means to pawn something and is also the British name for Rhenish white wine.

clue.text: Heather discovers where Othello had his roots

definitions.meaning: Othello was a Moor, so his homeland is the land of the Moors

explanation.surface: Heather finds out where Shakespeare's Othello came from.
explanation.definitionFit: Heather here stands for upland heath; split in two the word reads as the country of the Moors, Othello's people.

clue.text: Terrified to draw conclusions about African leader

indicators.note: about means the first piece goes round the second

parts.note: to infer is to draw conclusions

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Someone frightened to reach a verdict about an African head of state.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts A, the first letter of African, inside INFER.
explanation.definitionFit: Being frightened means being gripped by dread.

clue.text: Grounds for hostility in Rome

parts.note: the Latin term, as the Romans would say it, for a justification for going to war

explanation.walkthrough: 'in Rome' signals that the answer is a Latin phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: The Latin phrase literally means an occasion for war, a pretext for hostilities.

clue.text: Criminal conceals tool in smaller case

indicators.note: conceals means the case word holds the tool inside it

parts.note: less means smaller
an awl is a pointed boring tool

explanation.surface: A crook hides a tool inside a smaller box.
explanation.walkthrough: 'conceals' signals the container; 'in smaller case' pictures the tool held inside the comparative word.
explanation.definitionFit: Criminal behaviour disregards the rules of society.

clue.text: Scheme advanced reveals a professional attitude

parts.note: pro is short for professional
a position is a stance or attitude

explanation.surface: A suggested plan shows an expert's outlook.
explanation.definitionFit: A proposal is a plan put forward for consideration.

clue.text: Stop murder

explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means to cease work and, in slang, to kill.

clue.text: It drains away water from a small jug

parts.note: a ewer is a large water jug

explanation.surface: Water drains away from a little pitcher.
explanation.definitionFit: A drain pipe carries waste water away underground.

clue.text: Socially ubiquitous, no matter what occurs

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means in any case, and humorously, present at every social occasion.

clue.text: Stole over one thousand

parts.note: too means excessively, as over- does in overcautious
K stands for a thousand, as in kilo

explanation.surface: Someone pinched more than a grand.
explanation.definitionFit: To steal is to take what belongs to another.

clue.text: Honest gambling represents a complete change

parts.note: clean means honest, free of wrongdoing
a sweep, short for sweepstake, is a form of gambling

explanation.surface: Fair betting brings about a total transformation.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means a total clear-out, removing everything old.

clue.text: Dutch punter gets an equal cut

parts.note: a punter is someone who bets
an equal share of two is a half

explanation.surface: A gambler from the Netherlands gets a fair share of the winnings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dutch', from rhyming slang 'Duchess of Fife', is old Cockney for a wife; it is not about the Netherlands.
explanation.definitionFit: Old Cockney 'my old Dutch' means my wife, a spouse jokingly called the superior partner.

clue.text: Learns anew about sacred books and the light they shed

indicators.note: about means the reshuffled letters go round the books
anew means the word is made again in a fresh arrangement

parts.note: NT is the New Testament, a collection of sacred books

explanation.surface: Someone studies scripture afresh and gains illumination from it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'anew' gives LAERNS, which 'about' wraps round the books; the definition loosely refers to the lamps themselves, which shed light.
explanation.definitionFit: Portable lamps are the sources of light that are carried about.

clue.text: Opposed to cleric returning to South America

indicators.note: returning means the word for cleric is read backwards

parts.note: Rev is short for Reverend, a cleric
US stands for the United States, America

explanation.surface: A priest heading back to South America is against it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returning' turns REV into VER; 'South America' is not SA but S plus US.
explanation.definitionFit: The Latin word means against, as in a contest between two sides.

clue.text: I married Bill but he isn't what he claimed

parts.note: a bill is a poster

explanation.surface: A woman wed a man called Bill, only to discover he was a fraud.
explanation.definitionFit: A fraud pretends to be somebody he is not.

clue.text: Get his designs as examples of craft

indicators.note: designs suggests the letters are laid out to a new pattern

explanation.surface: Get his designs as samples of handiwork.
explanation.walkthrough: 'craft' means boats: eights are rowing boats with eight oarsmen.
explanation.definitionFit: Racing shells rowed by eight oarsmen are vessels, so are examples of craft.

clue.text: Initially Rex agrees to become a motor mechanic

indicators.note: to become means the letters are changed into something else
Initially picks the first letter of the following word

explanation.surface: Rex at first agrees to train as a garage worker.
explanation.walkthrough: R, the first letter of Rex, joins AGREES and 'to become' rearranges them.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang for a mechanic, since motor work involves oil and lubricant.

clue.text: Suggested by one representative with legal backing

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
an MP is a Member of Parliament, an elected representative
licit means legally allowed, having legal sanction

explanation.surface: Something proposed by a single MP with the law behind it.
explanation.definitionFit: Something implied is hinted at rather than stated outright.

clue.text: Bell-ringing soldiers? What a fantastic idea!

parts.note: a chime is a ringing of bells
RA is the Royal Artillery, a body of soldiers

explanation.surface: Soldiers who ring bells? An unlikely notion!
explanation.definitionFit: A wild, unrealisable fancy is like a mythical monster, a figment of imagination.

clue.text: Country recipe which was coined in Greece

parts.note: a state is a country
R is the abbreviation for recipe, as on prescriptions

explanation.surface: A national dish that originated in Greece.
explanation.definitionFit: An ancient Greek coin, so something minted there.

clue.text: Abhorrence for previous Community quota

parts.note: ex means former or previous
EC is the European Community
a ration is a fixed share, a quota

explanation.surface: Loathing for an old European allocation.
explanation.definitionFit: Detestation is intense loathing expressed against something.

clue.text: Her suicide accomplished nothing

parts.note: did means accomplished
O is a zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A woman's taking her own life achieved nothing.
explanation.walkthrough: The Queen of Carthage killed herself when Aeneas abandoned her, and he sailed on regardless.
explanation.definitionFit: The legendary Carthaginian queen took her own life after being deserted by Aeneas.

clue.text: Unfortunately within range of brutal assassin

indicators.note: within range of means the letters lie inside the stretch of words that follows

explanation.surface: Sadly, someone was in reach of a vicious killer.
explanation.definitionFit: An exclamation of grief, used to mean regrettably.

clue.text: An investment yielding good-quality return

indicators.note: return means the word for a good quality is read backwards

parts.note: an asset is a good quality

explanation.surface: A savings product giving a high-grade yield.
explanation.walkthrough: A TESSA was a Tax Exempt Special Savings Account, a British savings scheme of the 1990s.
explanation.definitionFit: The British tax-free savings scheme was a place to put money.

clue.text: Amounted to Edward admitting everything

indicators.note: admitting means the name lets the other word inside

parts.note: Ted is a short form of Edward
all means everything

explanation.surface: Ted owned up to the whole lot.
explanation.definitionFit: Added up to a sum, reached a figure.

clue.text: Aesthetic justification by Arthur on behalf of his own wine

parts.note: Art is a short form of Arthur
for means on behalf of
belonging to Arthur, so Art's
sake is Japanese rice wine

explanation.surface: Arthur defends himself by claiming his own wine.
explanation.definitionFit: The motto holds that creative work needs no moral or practical purpose beyond beauty.
